text: For a random variable over n outcomes, Shannon entropy H(X) is MAXIMIZED by which distribution?
choices: A deterministic distribution (one outcome with probability 1)
Any distribution — H is constant across them
explanation: The maximum-entropy bound gives H(X) ≤ log₂ n with equality iff X is uniform — maximal uncertainty. A deterministic distribution instead MINIMIZES entropy at H = 0 (no uncertainty); heavier skew lowers entropy; and H plainly varies with the distribution.
